gates: no label read before the committed registration and its verified public receipt (frc.common.registered)
'fit' and 'calibrate' reads need a committed, unchanged mechanism card under results/<campaign>/cards/ (path, SHA-256 and commit logged with the read)
MODEL_SELECT labels are never read by a fitting entry point (frc.fa, frc.ctl, frc.fs)
label reads run only inside a queue unit (FRC_UNIT_ID)
entry points can be added only by a dated, committed ACCESS_AMENDMENTS.json entry before first use
log: .private/<campaign>/access/LABEL_ACCESS.jsonl (append-only; utc, unit id, entry point, role, fields, operation, purpose, people, households, row-set hash, card)

benchmark.what: original-benchmark utility (24 clauses + 4 guards), the development reserve and paired utility costs of saved releases (logged adaptive evaluation; never a fitting input)

calibrate.what: calibration parameters only (CALIBRATION has no SEX label); not planned by the registered card

fit.what: fitting release parameters of the family, its task-only twin or a control on the full MODEL_FIT pool (household-grouped internal folds for any cross-fitting); SEX only as a training label of a protection objective (propensity and SEX-conditional occupation statistics) or as the evaluation label of the MODEL_FIT cross-fitted check

readers.what: fresh development reader grid (FIT / VALIDATION / SCORE reader roles inside MODEL_SELECT)

verify.what: independent verifier replay with separate metric, selection and reader code

source_artefacts: the new-release-mechanisms private artefacts are read-only inputs (SOURCE_ADMISSION.json); nothing is written under the source campaign's paths
